header.title: Wellness Portal
header.subtitle: Your well-being is an essential part of your journey at IIT Madras. Comprehensive health, counselling, and emotional wellness support is available to every student, whenever you need it.

emergencyHelplines.name: IITM Hospital Emergency
emergencyHelplines.description: Round-the-clock emergency medical response and institute ambulance dispatch.

emergencyHelplines.name: Institute Security Control Room
emergencyHelplines.description: Campus security, night escort assistance, and emergency rescue services.

emergencyHelplines.name: Tele-MANAS National Helpline
emergencyHelplines.description: Government of India national tele-mental health support across all regional languages.

supportServices.title: IIT Madras Wellness Community Center
supportServices.description: The Institute Wellness Community Center offers free, confidential counseling by licensed clinical psychologists and trained wellness counselors. Students can discuss academic pressure, personal concerns, stress, anxiety, or relationship issues in a safe, non-judgmental space.

supportServices.title: Saathi & MITR Peer Mentorship
supportServices.description: Saathi is IIT Madras's student-led wellness body, dedicated to mental health awareness, destigmatization, and proactive student welfare. MITR comprises trained faculty and senior student mentors who provide confidential guidance and peer listening.
features: De-stressing campaigns during quiz and exam weeks
Anonymous feedback and grievance redressal support

supportServices.title: IIT Madras Institute Hospital
supportServices.description: A full-fledged hospital facility inside the campus equipped with 24/7 Casualty & Outpatient Department (OPD), modern diagnostic laboratory, digital X-Ray, in-house pharmacy, and specialist visiting doctors (Cardiology, Orthopaedics, Dermatology, ENT, Dentistry, Psychiatry).
supportServices.location: Institute Hospital, Gajendra Circle Road, IIT Madras
supportServices.timings: OPD: 8:00 AM – 1:00 PM & 4:00 PM – 7:00 PM | Casualty: 24/7
features: Round-the-clock emergency medical response and ICU ambulance
Free consultation and subsidized medications for students
Student Medical Insurance Cashless coverage desk
Physiotherapy, clinical diagnostics, and vaccination center

supportServices.title: Online Tele-Counseling (24/7 Access)
supportServices.description: IIT Madras provides all enrolled students with free, unlimited access to leading online mental health platforms. Connect 24x7 via text chat, audio, or video calls from the comfort of your hostel room with certified therapists.
supportServices.timings: 24 Hours a Day, 365 Days a Year
features: Instant text chat with trained counselors anytime
Self-help assessments, guided meditations & audio tracks
Multi-lingual counseling in English, Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, and more

amsaInitiatives.title: Department Buddy & Mentor System
amsaInitiatives.description: Every incoming UG and PG student is paired with a departmental senior mentor who offers guidance on academic workloads, research lab navigation, and campus life adjustments.

amsaInitiatives.title: De-Stress Gatherings & Chai Pe Charcha
amsaInitiatives.description: Informal evening sessions organized by AMSA during mid-term and end-term exam periods to relax over tea, games, and music with fellow batchmates.

amsaInitiatives.title: Sports & Recreational Tournaments
amsaInitiatives.description: Department cricket, badminton (APL), and indoor tournaments designed to keep students physically active, refreshed, and socially connected.

amsaInitiatives.title: Faculty-Student Connect Sessions
amsaInitiatives.description: Open interactive forums where students can openly share academic stress or feedback directly with faculty advisors in a supportive setting.

selfCareResources.title: Managing Academic & Research Stress
points: Break large thesis/coursework milestones into small achievable tasks.
Maintain open communication with your guide/advisors early when stuck.
Set strict boundaries between lab hours and personal recharge time.

selfCareResources.title: Sleep Hygiene for Students
points: Aim for 7–8 hours of consistent sleep schedule even during project deadlines.
Avoid blue light screens at least 30 minutes before bedtime.
Keep your hostel room dark, quiet, and well-ventilated.

selfCareResources.title: Physical Fitness on Campus
points: Access the Institute Gym, Swimming Pool, and Sports Facilities inside the campus.
Take regular evening walks along the lush green campus trails.
Watch out for emails regarding special mindfulness sessions.

faqs.question: Is counseling at the Wellness Center confidential?
faqs.answer: Yes, absolutely 100% confidential. All discussions with counselors and clinical psychologists remain strictly confidential. Information is never shared with professors, department heads, parents, or future employers, adhering to strict medical ethics.

faqs.question: How can I book an appointment with a counsellor?
faqs.answer: You can call the wellness office at 044-2257-8521, email wellness1@smail.iitm.ac.in, or simply walk in to the Wellness Community Center near the Institute Hospital during working hours.

faqs.question: What should I do in an emergency late at night?
faqs.answer: For immediate physical medical emergencies, call the Institute Hospital Casualty at 044-2257-8333 / 8888 for immediate doctor assistance and ambulance dispatch. For urgent emotional distress or mental health crisis, call the 24x7 Saathi Helpline at 044-2257-5555 or the Tele-MANAS toll-free national helpline at 14416.

faqs.question: Are hospital consultations and medicines free for students?
faqs.answer: General outpatient consultations and regular essential medicines dispensed at the Institute Hospital pharmacy are free for all enrolled IIT Madras students. Hospitalization and specialized external treatments are covered under the Student Medical Insurance Scheme.

faqs.question: How can I get involved or reach out to the AMSA wellness team?
faqs.answer: You can reach out to any member of the AMSA Executive Team or your departmental mentor. You can also write directly to amsa@smail.iitm.ac.in or drop a message via the Contact Us page.
